title: [AI] fix(api): translate default rule stage at API boundary
issueTitle: Docs: rules API says stage must be pre/default/post, but "default" is rejected and null is undocumented
why: The report covers the API reference docs and the rules API validator, which a user reaches only by calling @actual-app/api against a server, so no action in the local web app shows a difference between the fixed and buggy builds.
